channel.title: The Local France - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Local France (thelocal.fr)

item.title: Versailles head tipped to take charge of Louvre after under-fire museum chief resigns
item.description: The president of France’s Palace of Versailles is expected to take over as head of the Louvre following the resignation of Laurence des Cars, AFP has reported.

item.title: OPINION: The death of Quentin Deranque will tilt France's elections
item.description: Two weeks after the death of Far Right activist Quentin Deranque in Lyon, John Lichfield looks at the political fallout of the death of this previously unknown figure, and how it will affect France's upcoming elections.

item.title: 'It's not just a piece of paper, I want to belong in France' - rejected citizenship applicants speak out
item.description: France's new tougher rules on French citizenship have seen an increasing number of people rejected on economic grounds - including young people who have spent almost their entire life in France. We spoke to some of those affected.

item.title: French chief executive of 2030 Olympic Games becomes latest director to quit
item.description: The chief executive of the 2030 Winter Olympics organising committee (Cojop) in the French Alps has stepped down after a serious falling out with the president Edgar Grospiron, it was announced on Wednesday.

item.title: France to review extremist groups after far-right activist killed
item.description: Ten days after the death of radical far-right activist Quentin Deranque, the French government announced initial measures targeting violent political action groups.

item.title: French expression of the day: En voir des vertes et des pas mûres
item.description: This French expression doesn't really mean checking if fruits are ripe or not.

item.title: Analysis: Is it still worth applying for French citizenship?
item.description: French citizenship brings with it many benefits, but tough new rules mean an increasing number of candidates are being rejected - so is it still worth spending the time and money to apply? And how likely is your application to succeed?

item.title: Revealed: The best places in France for winter sun
item.description: If the grey days of winter are getting you down, here is where to go in France that gives you the best chance of seeing the sun.

item.title: Are emotional support animals recognised in France?
item.description: What happens if you have an emotional support animal and you want to move to France with it, or you live here and want to get one? What are the laws surrounding these types of animals and their rights to access different public spaces and transport?

item.title: French minister Dati resigns to mount Paris mayoral bid
item.description: France's conservative culture minister Rachida Dati said Wednesday evening she had submitted her resignation in order to launch her bid for mayor of Paris.
